messages:
sam: Heads-up — deploy-bot just paused the promotion for release v2.4.1. Staging smoke failed; artifact-verify step showed a partial upload / checksum mismatch. Anyone able to triage?

deploy-bot: automated: Promotion paused for release=v2.4.1, stage=staging. reason=artifact_verify_failed checksum!=expected. see logs: https://ci.example.com/build/9821/logs :warning:

meera: on it, grabbing logs now. pinging storage infra.

jordan: I saw a couple multipart upload aborts earlier from runner pool A — could be the same class of failure. runner logs show 503 + client retry.

ci-bot: build #9821 artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/v2.4.1/manifest.json (partial=0x1c)

meera: storage says there was a short GC job on the mirror bucket at 02:10 UTC that coincided with the upload window. Mirror TTL was bumped in the last maintenance — looks like a race with multipart finalization.

sam: two options: 1) pin to last-good image (v2.4.0) and manual promote to keep prod uptime, 2) rerun CI and rebuild artifact after we confirm storage stable. opinions?

jordan: pin sounds safest short-term. We should document in release notes and follow up with a rollback plan if we need to revert to v2.4.1 later.

lina: +1 pin for immediate unblocking, but let's lock the deploy window to avoid auto-promote until we confirm root cause. Can we do a canary-only promote to validate?

meera: quick check — last-good image digest for v2.4.0 is sha256:abcd1234. I can trigger manual promote to staging->prod, but we need approval from release lead @sam.

sam: approve manual promote to prod with v2.4.0 digest. Add note: reason=artifact-verify failure; mitigation=pin last-good; follow-up=storage GC investigation; owner=@meera. Change window: immediate, will notify customers if we flip prod.

deploy-bot: ack. Initiating manual promote to prod using image sha256:abcd1234. will post progress.

srebot: reminder: create an incident ticket for storage GC/replication race (severity=high if we see repeat failure).

ci-bot: promote job started: job_id=promote-6723. waiting on prechecks.

meera: doing a quick smoke after promote to ensure no regressions on payment and auth flows.

jordan: also tagging the CI job to re-run artifact build once storage confirms GC is disabled — we shouldn't accept new uploads during re-run.

deploy-bot: promote job complete: status=success. prod now running image v2.4.0 (sha256:abcd1234).

lina: smoke in prod looks green for basic endpoints. running longer auth load now.

meera: added incident: INC-2026 storage mirror GC raced multipart finalize. Assigned to infra-team. Notes attached with error snippets.

sam: thanks. Action items: 1) infra to patch mirror GC timing and add upload-finalize guard, 2) CI to add artifact-verify retry/hard-fail flag or mirror write verification, 3) release-team to hold v2.4.1 until rebuild & verify. I'll draft a short release note: "Hotfix: pinned to v2.4.0 due to artifact upload verification failure; team investigating."

jordan: I'll add a brief changelog entry and an internal blurb for support.

ci-bot: scheduled rebuild for v2.4.1: queued (hold: storage infra confirm).

meera: infra says they disabled the GC run temporarily and added extra logging. We'll coordinate a controlled rebuild in ~30m.

sam: great. closing the thread for now — we promoted to last-good and opened incident. If anything changes ping here or @oncall. :thumbsup:
